notes: for … sake heads on for because the carrier is the proper preposition διά (rule 78); a head on sake would be right only for the postposition χάριν under rule 46.
The possessive adjective σῇ names the possessor and takes thy, so the article before γνώσει is unrepresented under rule 54 rather than rule 47.
ὁ ἀσθενῶν splits under rule 32: the article supplies he and nothing else, and the participle keeps the relativizer, the copula and the head on weak.
v011, v012 and v013 are selected on r00-base; every token of the projection has an English counterpart and no textual decision is taken here (rule 12).
